profile: A gentle mother reading aloud at bedtime
persona: A gentle mother reading aloud at bedtime

lines.text: Every evening, someone had to light the road.
But the wind does not care whose turn it is.
She could have kept climbing. She went back instead.
Because a light behind you is a road for someone else.

omni.design: female, middle-aged, moderate pitch, british accent
omni.ref_text: Long ago, when the hills were young, the lanterns of the valley were lit by hand, one by one, every single evening.
